blocks.text: Cara Delevingne released her debut album Not Normal via Warner Records — listen HERE. The album marks Cara’s first full length debut into the music world, in which she co-wrote every track on the album and co-produced alongside BJ Burton (Bon Iver, Charli xcx). Playing and writing music have been lifelong passions for Cara, and with her first album release, Cara showcases her talent by how masterfully she intertwines different sounds paired with her vulnerable lyrics.
